title: Illustration / Assigning color
slide_intent: Choose expressive color deliberately because literal coloring can miss an opportunity to communicate personality.
strategic_value: Unexpected blue and pink animals can make Duolingo illustrations feel playful and vibrant.
demonstration: Brown and blue dogs sit above gray and pink rabbits, with each pair labeled acceptable and better.
practical_value: Explore lively color alternatives while preserving recognition of the subject.
